name: Ace Radio
h1: One connected view across 21 stations and Create
lede: Keep sales, programming and digital delivery in one shared system.
why_p: A family-owned group spanning metro and regional markets, with a digital agency, a newspaper and programmatic audio, runs many parallel workflows that rarely share one view.

signals.title: 21 stations across 12 markets
signals.body: Ace Radio's site describes 21 stations over twelve population centres across Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane, regional Victoria and Southern NSW, plus The Weekly Advertiser and the Create digital agency.
signals.angle: Coordinating campaigns, bookings and programming across 12 markets is a natural fit for one shared base.

signals.title: New Chief Commercial Officer
signals.body: Jim Glennon was named Chief Commercial Officer from 1 February 2025, leading commercial strategy across metro, regional and digital platforms.
signals.angle: Aligning commercial strategy across platforms needs one view of pipeline, bookings and delivery.

signals.title: Hit Network programming supply
signals.body: From 16 January 2023 Ace supplies Southern Cross Austereo Hit Network programs.
signals.angle: Content-supply commitments need clear scheduling and ownership across partners.

signals.title: Metro expansion in Melbourne, Sydney and Brisbane
signals.body: Magic 1278, 2UE and 4BH came under Ace control in 2022, with the lease takeover dated 14 January 2022.
signals.angle: Rapid growth means workflows built for regional stations need to scale to metro operations.
